items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: They named the girl Louise but my brother and the rest of the family called her Sis. We were very fond of her but unfortunatly Louise died from a brain haemorrhage when she was 5 years old.

ctx.x: Madelyn and I were living with my mother and sister. My mother thought that perhaps if I changed the climate and went to Crawfordsville, Indiana, it may be good for me. I had seen a couple of doctors and couldn't find out what was wrong with me. So Madelyn and I went to Crawfordsville and stayed with my Aunt Sarah. After being there for one week, one night my pains stopped suddenly. The next day a message came from my father, saying that Leah had given birth to a girl at a certain time and that time coincided…
They named the girl Louise but my brother and the rest of the family called her Sis. We were very fond of her but unfortunatly Louise died from a brain haemorrhage when she was 5 years old.

We worked quite a long time at the Road House in Newport and when we left that job, Helvey decided to enlarge the orchestra because we started doing dance work in West Virginia, Kentucky and other cities in Ohio.
